name: vibe.engineer
conclusion: vibe.engineer (Ask) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 3 autonomy limits, 2 clarification rules, 2 approval gates, 1 escalation rule; none for validation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 3 autonomy limits (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose: allowed tools; batching bd CLI calls; starting implementation in this session.

statements.quote: allowed-tools: Bash, Read, Glob, Grep, Agent, AskUserQuestion, Skill
Do NOT batch (`bd` CLI lock — concurrent calls fail).
Once the plan and issues exist, do NOT start implementation in this session.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly heading: clarifying before planning; scope, constraints and definition of done.

statements.quote: Ask the user clarifying questions until scope, constraints, and definition of done are unambiguous.

approval_gates.conclusion: 2 approval gates (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose: creating issues; writing any code.

statements.quote: Get explicit approval before creating issues.
Wait for a direct instruction before writing any code.

escalation.conclusion: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: SessionStart status not beads ready.

statements.quote: Refuse to proceed if SessionStart status ≠ `beads: ready`.
